text:
sarah_sales: FYI - TeleWell sent an RFP this morning. Key asks: on-prem/private deployment option, HSM-based KMS, mandatory PII redaction before logs leave their network, and a capability matrix by EOD Thu. Can SE + SRE help scope POC and pricing?

rahul_se: Thanks — can you drop the RFP link and the exact redaction requirement? (e.g., do they want client-side redaction, or just on-server before egress)

sarah_sales: Link: https://telewell.example.com/rfp/telewell-2026-03.pdf. Quote from sec section: "All PHI must be redacted at source or never leave customer VPC in cleartext; HSM key lifecycle managed by customer." They want a two-week POC for messaging flows and a pricing estimate for Dedicated + Private package.

priya_se: Re: redaction — we can offer two paths: 1) client-side SDK redaction + tokenization before hitting our API, or 2) Private deployment in their VPC with HSM proxied keys so raw text never leaves. Option 2 has higher infra + setup cost.

oliver_sre: For option 2 we need to confirm network topology and whether they allow port access to our management plane. Also need to know expected QPS and peak tokens to size GPU pool + burst.

rahul_se: Can we propose a hybrid: keep tokenization in-customer (edge lambda) + send encrypted payload to Redwood Private where HSM unwraps keys? That reduces their compliance burden and shortens POC.

min_legal: Quick legal note: we need to confirm whether TeleWell accepts our SOC2 + annual pen test report and whether they require contract language around key custody. If they insist on customer-managed HSM with no Redwood access, we'll need an on-prem appliance deployment and a different SOW.

priya_se: I'll draft two capability matrix rows: "PII redaction approaches" and "Key custody models". Rahul/OIiver — what short bullets should I use for the POC deliverables?

rahul_se: POC deliverables (short): 1) sample messaging flow with redaction tokenization, 2) throughput test at 100 rps 2KB payloads, 3) E2E audit log showing no cleartext egress, 4) ops runbook for key rotation.

oliver_sre: Add: deployment checklist for VPC peering, firewall rules, and HA nodes. Also estimate 24-48h for initial infra provisioning.

attachments-bot: uploaded "telewell-security-qna.xlsx" and "capability-matrix-draft.csv" to thread (links: internal).

sarah_sales: Great — TeleWell expects pricing tiers in the matrix: POC (2w) fixed fee, Dedicated monthly, Private one-time setup + monthly. Can finance / pricing confirm ballpark numbers?

priya_se: I'll fill the matrix with placeholders: POC $12k, Dedicated from $6k/mo, Private setup $45k + $8k/mo. Mark as draft. Please flag if those are wildly off.

min_legal: Also flag contractual SLA: they'll want 99.9% for Dedicated and data deletion certification after POC. Add clause note.

rahul_se: Action items: Priya - update capability-matrix with the two redaction paths and pricing placeholders by EOD Wed. Oliver - provide provisioning ETA + firewall snippet. Min - confirm if TeleWell's sec questionnaire requires custom contract language. Sarah - confirm decision-maker timeline (they said procurement meets Friday).

sarah_sales: Confirmed. TeleWell procurement meets Fri. I'll set up a quick call tomorrow 9am PT with their security lead and ours. @rahul_se @priya_se please join.

priya_se: On call. I'll bring the draft matrix and a short demo script.

oliver_sre: On call. I'll have the firewall snippet ready: ```
# Example peer rule
allow tcp 443 from telewell-vpc to redwood-private-proxy:443
allow 10250-10255 from redwood-admin to telewell-vpc
```

rahul_se: If we go hybrid tokenization, we should include a tiny SDK snippet in the matrix: ```js
// client-side redact
const redacted = redactPII(message);
sendToRedwood(encrypt(redacted, key));
```

attachments-bot: note: capability-matrix-draft.csv version 0.1 created by priya_se.

sarah_sales: Thanks team — I'll ping again after the security call. :thumbsup:
